skill.summary: 自动将 Markdown 文章转为适配微信公众号格式的 HTML，并批量发布至公众号草稿箱，支持封面图生成与专题管理。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Automates publishing Markdown articles to WeChat Official Account drafts.

- Converts Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML
- Automatically generates cover images (via rule-based or AI model)
- Supports batch publishing and multi-topic management
- Simple setup with environment variables for WeChat and optional AI image API
- Includes tools for publishing and cover generation
